commit 05d066fa3fbfb9c3bd5ca1ed43e1fd75b21a4239
Author: Joe Crawford <joe@artlung.com>
Date:   Wed Jun 5 17:06:05 2024 +0000

    Bug 1889422 Fluent Migration Follow-Up irc.properties. r=rjl
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D210499

diff --git a/chat/locales/en-US/irc.ftl b/chat/locales/en-US/irc.ftl
index fa65c96d121..4d129c24ea2 100644
--- a/chat/locales/en-US/irc.ftl
+++ b/chat/locales/en-US/irc.ftl
@@ -17,6 +17,7 @@ connection-error-time-out = Connection timed out
 connection-error-invalid-username = { $username } is not an allowed username
 connection-error-invalid-password = Invalid server password
 connection-error-password-required = Password required
+connection-error-invalid-user-password = Invalid password
 
 # LOCALIZATION NOTE (join-chat-*):
 #   These show up on the join chat menu. An underscore is for the access key.
diff --git a/chat/protocols/irc/ircSASL.sys.mjs b/chat/protocols/irc/ircSASL.sys.mjs
index 48b836140d1..51965096848 100644
--- a/chat/protocols/irc/ircSASL.sys.mjs
+++ b/chat/protocols/irc/ircSASL.sys.mjs
@@ -8,12 +8,13 @@
  *   https://ircv3.net/specs/extensions/sasl-3.2
  */
 
-import { l10nHelper } from "resource:///modules/imXPCOMUtils.sys.mjs";
 import { ircHandlerPriorities } from "resource:///modules/ircHandlerPriorities.sys.mjs";
 
 const lazy = {};
-ChromeUtils.defineLazyGetter(lazy, "_", () =>
-  l10nHelper("chrome://chat/locale/irc.properties")
+ChromeUtils.defineLazyGetter(
+  lazy,
+  "l10n",
+  () => new Localization(["chat/irc.ftl"], true)
 );
 
 export var ircSASL = {
@@ -99,7 +100,7 @@ export var ircSASL = {
       this.ERROR("Authentication with SASL failed.");
       this.gotDisconnected(
         Ci.prplIAccount.ERROR_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED,
-        lazy._("connection.error.invalidUserPassword")
+        lazy.l10n.formatValueSync("connection-error-invalid-user-password")
       );
       return true;
     },
